title: Best Small Business Time Clocks: 8 Top Picks for 2026
summary: Compare the best small business time clock apps for 2026 by GPS tracking, free plans, payroll integrations, and price. Find the right fit for your hourly team.
body_markdown:
Someone forgets to clock out. Another teammate takes a longer break than planned. By payday, the hours on your[timesheet](https://www.joinhomebase.com/timesheets) don’t match the hours worked.


Payroll mistakes happen at every size. A 2022[EY survey](https://eyquest.com/files/Cost_and_Risks_Due_to_Payroll_Errors_2022_Final.pdf) of 508 payroll decision-makers at US companies with 250 to 10,000 employees found an average payroll accuracy rate of 80.15%. Each[payroll error](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/payroll-errors) cost an average of $291 to fix.


Picking the best small business time clock comes down to three things: how many sites you run, whether you need a free plan, and how the app connects to your payroll. We compared eight apps on those points and on price.


## **The Best Small Business Time Clocks for 2026**


Not sure where to start? Match the app to your biggest headache:


- **Field or multi-site crews:**[Connecteam](https://www.joinhomebase.com/compare/homebase-vs-connecteam) or ClockShark
- **Free for tiny teams:**[Clockify](https://www.joinhomebase.com/comparison/clockify) (five users) or Jibble (unlimited users)
- **Stopping buddy punching:** Buddy Punch or Jibble
- **QuickBooks users:** QuickBooks Time
- **Shift scheduling first:**[Deputy](https://www.joinhomebase.com/compare/homebase-vs-deputy) or[When I Work](https://www.joinhomebase.com/homebase-vs-wheniwork)


We make Homebase, so we left it out of the ranking. You’ll find how we compare below.

## **Physical Time Clocks vs. Digital Time Clock Apps**


[Physical clocks](https://www.joinhomebase.com/time-clock/punch-clock) still work for teams with no smartphones on the floor.[Biometric terminals](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/biometric-time-clock) can help stop[buddy punching](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/buddy-punching) , but they cost more upfront.


Take the uAttend JR2000. It reads fingerprints, RFID cards, and PINs, and lists at $179.99, plus a subscription from $28 a month for one to nine employees ([uAttend](https://uattend.com/shop-uattend/touch-tablet-wifi-time-clock-jr2000/) ).


For most small businesses, we think a digital[time clock app](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/your-guide-to-the-employee-time-clock) is the better call. Soma Franks, co-owner of Sweetwater Harvest Kitchen, puts it this way: “Before we switched to Homebase I was tabulating hours from a manual punch clock!”


## **How We Chose the Best Small Business Time Clocks**


We make a time clock app, so we’re not neutral. That’s why Homebase isn’t in the ranking. We read each app’s published pricing and documentation and checked Capterra ratings (snapshot November 1, 2026). We didn’t hands-on test every app.


We compared fit, free plans, price, GPS and geofencing, payroll integrations, offline behavior, and ratings, weighted around[what owners tell us](https://www.joinhomebase.com/customers) : fewer payroll corrections, a clock-in method their team will use, and prices that don’t jump with every hire.


## **The 8 Best Small Business Time Clock Apps for 2026**


Every app below does at least one thing better than the rest. See our guides to the[best mobile time clock apps](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/best-mobile-time-clock-app) and[clock in clock out apps](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/clock-in-clock-out-apps) .


### **Connecteam: Best for Deskless and Field-Based Teams**


**Who is this best for?** Field-based or multi-site teams that want GPS, scheduling, and chat in one app.


**Why we picked it:** If your crew spends the day away from a front counter, Connecteam stamps each punch with a location. Geofencing comes with the free plan and, on paid plans, starts at Advanced (10 sites) and goes unlimited at Expert. Employees[clock in](https://www.joinhomebase.com/glossary/clock-in) by phone, computer, or NFC tag, and some plans add[kiosk](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/time-clock-kiosk) clock-in.


**Integrations:** ADP Run and Workforce Now, QuickBooks Online, Gusto, Xero, and Paychex Flex.


**Pros:** Free for up to 10 users, with scheduling and chat included.


**Cons:** The free plan allows one time clock and one job schedule. Standard clock-ins need internet.


**Pricing:** Free up to 10 users. Basic is $29 a month annual or $35 monthly for the first 30 users, Advanced is $49 or $59, and Expert is $99 or $119. **Capterra:** 4.6 (5,322 reviews).


### **Clockify: Best Free Time Clock App for Tiny Teams**


**Who is this best for?** Solo operators and teams of five or fewer.


**Why we picked it:** Clockify is an easy pick when the budget is tight. The free plan covers five active users, and paid plans start at $3.99 per user. See our[best free time clock apps](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/best-free-time-clock-app) .


**Integrations:** QuickBooks Online (Essentials, Plus, and Advanced) on Standard and up. Accounts with QuickBooks payroll enabled need a separate paid add-on.


**Pros:** Free for five users. Low entry price.


**Cons:** On April 21, 2026, Clockify capped the free plan at five users and moved kiosk, billable hours, shared reports, project estimates, and CSV and Excel exports to paid plans ([CAKE.com](https://cake.com/blog/?p=5014) ). GPS requires Pro.


**Pricing:** Basic is $3.99 per user annual or $4.99 monthly, Standard is $5.49 or $6.99, and Pro is $7.99 or $9.99. **Capterra:** 4.8 (9,275 reviews).


### **Jibble: Best Free Time Clock With Biometric Verification**


**Who is this best for?** Teams that want GPS and facial recognition without a monthly fee.


**Why we picked it:** Jibble’s free plan has no user cap, so adding teammates doesn’t add cost. Per Jibble’s website, it includes GPS, facial recognition, geofencing, and offline tracking.


**Integrations:** QuickBooks, Xero, and Deel, listed among its integrations and export options.


**Pros:** Free for unlimited users.


**Cons:** Offline mode covers clock-in and clock-out only, so breaks, reminders, and automatic clock-outs wait until the device reconnects.


**Pricing:** Free for unlimited users. **Capterra:** 4.8 (3,195 reviews).


### **QuickBooks Time: Best for QuickBooks Users**


**Who is this best for?** Businesses that run payroll or accounting in QuickBooks Online.


**Why we picked it:** If QuickBooks already runs your books, this is the natural fit. Hours sync without manual imports, and geofencing comes with Elite.


**Integrations:** QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Payroll.


**Pros:** Native sync.


**Cons:** Requires QuickBooks Online. No free plan.


**Pricing:** Premium is $20 base plus $10 per user, and Elite is $40 plus $12. Eligible new customers get 50% off the base fee for three months. **Capterra:** 4.7 (7,026 reviews).


### **Buddy Punch: Best for Strong Clock-In Verification**


**Who is this best for?** Small teams that want clock-in verification and many payroll integrations.


**Why we picked it:** Buddy Punch gives you several ways to confirm who’s clocking in. Every plan records GPS with punches, and Pro adds PIN and kiosk punching, QR codes, webcam photos, geofencing, and offline mode.


**Integrations:** QuickBooks Online and Desktop, ADP Workforce Now, Gusto, Paychex, Paylocity, Paycor, Rippling, Workday, and Justworks.


**Pros:** Several verification methods.


**Cons:** A $19 monthly base fee applies to every plan. Real-time GPS comes with Advanced or costs $2 per user on Starter and Pro.


**Pricing:** Starter is $4.99 per user annual or $5.99 monthly, Pro is $6.99 or $7.99, and Advanced is $12.99 or $13.99. **Capterra:** 4.8 (1,141 reviews).


### **Deputy: Best for Multi-Location Shift Teams**


**Who is this best for?** Multi-location shift teams that want scheduling and a time clock together.


**Why we picked it:** Deputy pairs a time clock with scheduling, shift swaps, and leave management, which suits teams juggling several locations. Core and Pro add face unlock at the kiosk.


**Integrations:** Gusto, ADP RUN, and ADP Workforce Now.


**Pros:** Scheduling and time clock together, from $5 per user on annual billing.


**Cons:** Monthly plans carry a $30 minimum per invoice. There’s no free plan.


**Pricing:** On annual billing, Lite is $5 per user, Core is $6.50, and Pro is $9. **Capterra:** 4.6 (775 reviews).


### **ClockShark: Best for Construction and Field Service Teams**


**Who is this best for?** Trades and field service crews that need job costing and GPS.


**Why we picked it:** ClockShark ties time to jobs. Standard includes GPS, geofencing, job tracking, and scheduling, and Pro adds paid time off, advanced job costing, and mileage tracking.


**Integrations:** QuickBooks, ADP, Sage, Xero, Zapier, Paychex, Simpro, Gusto, and MYOB.


**Pros:** GPS and geofencing in the entry plan.


**Cons:** A three-year contract applies to all plans. A five-person crew on Standard pays $89.50 a month.


**Pricing:** Standard is $42 base plus $9.50 per user, and Pro is $63 plus $11.50. A 14-day trial is available. **Capterra:** 4.7 (1,911 reviews).


### **When I Work: Best for Scheduling-First Shift Teams**


**Who is this best for?** Shift-based teams that start with scheduling.


**Why we picked it:** When I Work starts with your schedule, then adds the time clock. Clock-ins support GPS location restrictions.


**Integrations:** ADP RUN and Workforce Now, Gusto, Paychex, QuickBooks Online, Rippling, and Square.


**Pros:** Low entry price.


**Cons:** There’s no permanent free plan, only a 14-day trial. Photo clock-in works on the iOS terminal app only.


**Pricing:** Scheduling plans are $2.50 per user (Essentials), $5 (Pro), and $8 (Premium).[Time tracking and attendance](https://www.joinhomebase.com/glossary/time-and-attendance) is listed as a separate option on its pricing page, so the time clock may cost extra. **Capterra:** 4.5 (1,300 reviews).

## **GPS and Biometric Clock-Ins: What to Know First**


Location tracking makes a time clock more accurate, and it comes with notice and consent rules. This is general information, not legal advice, so check your state’s rules or talk to an employment attorney.


When an employee clocks in, the app records the phone’s location. With[geofencing](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/best-geofencing-time-clock) , punches outside the radius you set get flagged or blocked. Some apps log location only at each punch, as we do, while others show it during a shift, like Buddy Punch’s real-time GPS. See our guide to[GPS time clock apps](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/gps-time-clock-app) .


No single federal statute covers every private employer’s use of[GPS tracking](https://www.joinhomebase.com/glossary/gps-time-tracking) , and state monitoring laws differ.


**Maine:** LD 61 took effect July 29, 2026. It requires advance notice, interview-stage disclosure, and annual written notice, and it lets employees decline surveillance apps on personal devices. GPS tracking or other safety devices on vehicles the employer owns but the employee operates are excluded. Fines run $100 to $500 ([§620-A](https://www.legislature.maine.gov/statutes/26/title26sec620-A.html) ,[Maine DOL](https://www.maine.gov/labor/docs/2026/bls/BLSLaborStandardsLawsWebinar.pdf) ).


**Connecticut:**[Public Act 26-73](https://www.cga.ct.gov/2026/ACT/PA/PDF/2026PA-00073-R00SB-00472-PA.PDF) , effective October 1, 2026, requires employers to notify employees of the types and specific locations of electronic monitoring. A conspicuous posting counts as the notice, and new hires get a plain-language statement. Limited exceptions apply, including airports and security or safety monitoring. Penalties run $500 to $3,000. It isn’t a GPS law and concerns monitoring on the employer’s premises.


**New York and Delaware:** Both regulate notice of telephone, email, and internet monitoring, not GPS time clocks ([N.Y. Civil Rights Law §52-c](https://www.nysenate.gov/legislation/laws/CVR/52-C) ,[19 Del. C. §705](https://delcode.delaware.gov/title19/c007/sc001/index.html) ).


**Illinois BIPA:**[740 ILCS 14](https://www.ilga.gov/legislation/ilcs/fulltext?DocName=074000140K15) requires written notice and release before collecting biometric identifiers or information, such as fingerprints or face geometry scans. Damages are $1,000 per negligent and $5,000 per intentional or reckless violation. A 2024 amendment limits recovery for repeated collection from the same person by the same method to one recovery, and the Seventh Circuit applied it to pending cases ([Clay v. Union Pacific](https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/appellate-courts/ca7/25-2185/25-2185-2026-04-01.html) , April 2026). Other states have biometric laws too, so see our[state labor law guides](https://www.joinhomebase.com/state-labor-laws) .

## **Frequently Asked Questions About Small Business Time Clocks**


### **What Is the Best Time Clock App for Small Businesses?**


It depends on your team.[Connecteam](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/connecteam-alternatives) fits field crews, Clockify fits teams of five or fewer, and QuickBooks Time fits QuickBooks users. For hourly shift teams, we tie the time clock to scheduling and payroll.


### **Can GPS Time Clocks Prevent Time Theft?**


They help, but not completely. GPS and geofencing cut off-site punches, but they won’t catch a coworker using a shared PIN. Pair location checks with photo verification or unique PINs.


### **What Is the Best Free Time Clock App for Small Business?**


Homebase Basic is free for one location and up to 10 employees. Connecteam’s free plan covers 10 users, Clockify’s covers five, and Jibble advertises unlimited users. Compare what each one includes.


### **What Is the Best Mobile Time Clock With GPS?**


Look for location stamps on each punch and a geofence radius. Connecteam, Buddy Punch, ClockShark, Jibble, and Homebase offer[GPS clock-in](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/best-gps-time-clock-solutions) , and geofencing depends on the plan.


### **How Does GPS Time Tracking Work for Employees?**


The app records the phone’s location with each punch. With geofencing, it flags or blocks punches outside your radius. Employees need to allow location access.


### **Is It Legal to Track Employees’ GPS Location?**


It depends on where you operate. No single federal statute covers every employer’s GPS use, and Maine, Connecticut, New York, and Delaware each regulate monitoring notice differently.[Tell your team in writing](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/clocking-in-and-out-policy) what you track.


### **Do Time Clock Apps Work Offline?**


Some do. Connecteam’s standard clock-ins need internet. Buddy Punch offers offline mode on Pro. Jibble allows offline clock-in and clock-out, but not breaks, reminders, or automatic clock-outs.


### **Which Time Clock Apps Integrate With QuickBooks, ADP, and Gusto?**


Connecteam, Buddy Punch, ClockShark,[Deputy](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/deputy-alternatives) , and Homebase list ADP and Gusto. All but Deputy list QuickBooks, and QuickBooks Time syncs natively.


### **How Do You Stop Buddy Punching?**


Give each person a unique PIN, turn on photo verification, restrict punches with geofencing, and review timesheet edits.


### **Should a Small Business Use a Physical Time Clock or an App?**


An app suits most small businesses because it gives you[real-time visibility](https://www.joinhomebase.com/glossary/attendance-tracking) and payroll connections. A physical clock suits teams without smartphones.


### **How Much Do Time Clock Apps Cost?**


Compare totals at your team size. Per-user pricing starts at $2.50 (When I Work) or $3.99 (Clockify, annual). Three apps add a base fee, while Homebase charges per location.


### **What Is the 7-Minute Rule?**


It’s a common way to[round punches to the nearest quarter hour](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/time-clock-rounding) , not a separate law. Punches one to seven minutes past a quarter-hour mark may round down, and eight to 14 minutes may round up. Under[29 CFR 785.48(b)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-29/subtitle-B/chapter-V/subchapter-B/part-785/subpart-D/section-785.48) , the policy must average out over time and can’t systematically underpay employees. State rules may be stricter. Try our[time card calculator](https://www.joinhomebase.com/free-time-card-calculator) .
